unresolved_added: Equation 1-3 use a signed anaerobic-energy convention but never state the admissible phase switch or how recovery is clipped at AWC; the same differential rule can imply energy above capacity.
Equation 3 diverges as T approaches zero, and Equation 4 is introduced as a cap without a calibrated physiologic maximum or a proof that it remains above the chosen P.
Equation 5-6 use alpha, AWC, and Pc with mixed notation (the prose also prints AWS once); coefficient units and fit uncertainty are not closed.
The numerical Power-Duration fit reports alpha, Pc, and AWC but no raw observations, fitting objective, residuals, weighting, confidence intervals, or validation split.
Equation 8 attenuates alpha by a term containing alpha itself; for sufficiently large Wex the coefficient can become negative, yet no lower bound or reset rule is given.
The rider profile comparison supplies three parameter triples but does not provide the source rows, sex-specific sample definition, or uncertainty behind the curves.
Equation 9-11 are singular when relative velocity is zero and depend on an unstated wind-direction convention; lateral wind components are discarded by projection.
The prose repeats lambda as 97.7 percent and 097.7 percent while also using mu for friction; the parameter identity is internally ambiguous.
Equation 13 writes finite differences for kinetic energy as m v Delta-v/Delta-t without a clear evaluation point, then Equation 14 mixes vi and v conventions.
Equation 15 contains a/v and therefore requires v>0; the paper gives no coefficient derivation, initialization, numerical solver, step tolerance, or failure handling.
Equation 17 integrates section time but the text does not publish the initial speed, section length, denominator positivity rule, or the numerical integration method.
Equation 18-20 combine tangential and normal tire forces but do not define ftau numerically or explain how wind and slope change the static-friction budget.
Equation 21's fourth-root safe-speed expression has unresolved dimensions and an unclear sign inside the radicand; invalid radicands are not handled.
Equation 22 constrains an integral of dt as total energy and names Elim without a power integrand or value, so the total-energy constraint is not operationally closed.
The SA algorithm omits initial and terminal temperatures, cooling factor values, proposal variance, iteration count, random seed, and a reproducible stopping tolerance.
The flow chart accepts a candidate after a stochastic comparison but does not show whether the current best is separately retained or how infeasible states are repaired.
The 6146-second constant-power baseline and 29 percent improvement have no replicate count, seed, confidence interval, or exact optimized total time.
The self-designed course is generated by normally distributed points and spline interpolation without a seed, point list, smoothing rule, or physical plausibility check.
Wind sensitivity uses a small set of scattered points and stochastic SA output; no confidence bands, repeated runs, effect-size definition, or one-factor isolation is supplied.
Equation 24 writes epsilon as both a deviation scale and a normal-distribution parameter, leaving variance versus standard deviation ambiguous.
Equations 25-26 sequentially clamp each section but do not show that the repair preserves the energy state, total-energy constraint, or the nominal target comparison.
The sensitivity text uses k through 1000 while the principal Olympic course uses 1164 sections; the two indexes and total-time sums are not reconciled.
The team model assumes identical riders, constant safe spacing, instantaneous formation changes, and 720 or 24 permutations without calibrating drafting coefficients or collision dynamics.
The complex team objective optimizes drop point, power, and ordering but reports no numerical drop point, objective value, convergence trace, fourth-finisher tie rule, or individual fatigue state.
Guidance says wind need not concern the rider even though course 2 is reported as wind-speed and direction sensitive; the communication claim is not reconciled with the sensitivity result.

No appendix or code listing supplies topographic arrays, fitted parameters, solver settings, SA seeds, permutation coefficients, sensitivity data, or the plotted output arrays, preventing end-to-end reproduction.
